title: Landing check: warn on the approval card when uncommitted files in the main checkout would block the landing
lead: *Proposed.* Before the owner approves, the run pane of a run that awaits approval warns when the main checkout has uncommitted or untracked files that the landing's fast-forward merge would collide with, and names them. Approval is still allowed; this only moves the discovery from after the approval to before it.

sections.heading: Why
sections.body:
Friction found in the v1.1 prescan (2026-10-31). Landing runs `git merge --ff-only BRANCH` in the main checkout (`internal/engine/land.go:61-62`; `docs/design.md:409-411`). If an uncommitted change or an untracked file in the main checkout is in the way, git refuses, the run pauses with git's message (`pauseWith("git merge --ff-only ...")`), and the owner learns it only after approving. The owner then cleans the checkout and presses `t` (retry). The approval card says what approval does (`cardLandNote`, `internal/tui/card.go:437-449`; `docs/dashboard.md`, Approval card) but not whether it will work.

A plain "main is dirty" test would warn almost always: on 2026-10-31 `git status --porcelain` in this repo's main checkout lists ten modified `.slicer/` files (render output and the index), and the landing still works because the merge does not touch them. Git blocks a fast-forward only for a path that is both changed in the working tree or untracked in the main checkout and changed by the merge. So the check compares the two sets. Which paths the merge will bring: ork commits only after approval, so at approval time the slice's changes are uncommitted in the worktree; the paths are `git -C WORKTREE diff --name-only MERGE_BASE` plus `git -C WORKTREE ls-files --others --exclude-standard`, with `MERGE_BASE` from `git -C WORKTREE merge-base BASE HEAD`. The base branch is the branch the main checkout is on (`internal/engine/land.go:44-50`, owner, 2026-10-31 for S131; `docs/design.md:397`).

Slicer check: `slicer find dirty` and `slicer find ff-only` list only done ork items (S142, S178, S183) and none covers this. Landing is ork's (`landing.in-ork`, adj 162).

Open owner questions (MANIFEST-E.md, LM-Q1 to LM-Q3). The Implement steps use the recommended answer; if the owner picks another, the named step changes.

sections.heading: Files
sections.body:
This slice touches `internal/engine` and `internal/daemon`: it is an E-class slice (at most one such slice per wave). It also touches `internal/tui` and a golden view.

- `internal/engine/landcheck.go` (new): LandCheck type and CheckLanding(ctx, deps, project, record).
- `internal/engine/landcheck_test.go` (new), using the git-repo helpers in `internal/engine/land_test.go:81-100` (gitRun, writeFile, newLandEnv).
- `internal/daemon/runs.go:33-41` (method constant run.landcheck) and :1160-1182 (handleRun dispatch, beside run.report and run.render), plus a runLandCheck handler.
- `internal/daemon/handlers.go:137` (add the method to the run-method case).
- `internal/daemon/client.go` (a LandCheck(ctx, run) method) and `internal/daemon/runs_test.go` or a new `internal/daemon/landcheck_test.go`.
- `internal/tui/live.go:15-35`, `internal/tui/daemon.go` (wrapper), `internal/tui/live_test.go:24` (fakeLive).
- `internal/tui/pane.go:560-585` (the card footer: the warning line, with a priority that outlasts cardLandNote) and the pane-open and refresh paths in `internal/tui/pane.go` that call the check.
- `internal/tui/card.go:437-466` (a cardLandWarning helper beside cardLandNote) and `internal/tui/card_test.go`.
- `testdata/golden/pane-approval-card-80x24-mono-false.txt` and `-true.txt` (existing; unchanged when there is no blocker) and new `testdata/golden/pane-approval-card-landwarn-80x24-mono.txt`, `pane-approval-card-landwarn-100x30-mono.txt`.
- `docs/dashboard.md` (Approval card list, ~:939-958), `docs/design.md:395-420` (land step 2, and the methods table at :96-120), `docs/state.md` (no change unless LM-Q1 stores the result), `docs/guide.md` section 10 (one sentence).
- `CHANGELOG.md` (an entry under ## Unreleased, marked *proposed*).

Pair planning: E-class. It must not share a wave with another E-class slice (for example the named wave). It can pair with an N-class slice that does not edit `internal/tui/pane.go`, `internal/tui/card.go` or `docs/dashboard.md`.

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body:
`internal/engine/landcheck_test.go` (the function does not exist: compile error first):
- `TestCheckLandingCleanMainHasNoBlockers`: nothing dirty in main gives no blockers.
- `TestCheckLandingIgnoresDirtyFilesTheMergeDoesNotTouch`: main has a modified `.slicer/index.json` and an untracked `scratch.txt`, the slice changes `a.go`: no blockers.
- `TestCheckLandingNamesATrackedFileModifiedInMain`: main has an uncommitted edit to `a.go` and the slice changes `a.go` (committed on its branch): blocker `a.go`.
- `TestCheckLandingCountsUncommittedWorktreeChanges`: the slice's change is still uncommitted in the worktree (the state at approval): blocker found.
- `TestCheckLandingNamesAnUntrackedFileInTheWay`: main has an untracked `b.go` and the slice adds `b.go`: blocker `b.go`.
- `TestCheckLandingHandlesRenamesAndSpaces`: `-z` output parsing: a renamed file in main and a path with a space.
- `TestCheckLandingReportsAMainCheckoutThatIsNotOnABranch` (only if LM-Q2 includes it): same reason text the landing uses (`internal/engine/land.go:46-50`).
- `TestCheckLandingGitFailureIsAnErrorNotAWarning`: a git failure returns `Error`, no blockers.
- `TestCheckLandingNeverWrites`: the fake git log has only read commands (`status`, `diff`, `ls-files`, `merge-base`, `symbolic-ref`); no `merge`, `add`, `checkout`, `stash`.
- `TestLandPauseStillHappensWhenTheCheckWasSkipped`: the existing landing pause on a blocked fast-forward (`TestLandPausesWhenTheFastForwardFails`, `land_test.go:720`) is unchanged: the check is a warning only.

`internal/daemon`:
- `TestRunLandCheckOnlyForAwaitingApprovalWithLandStop`: a run in another state, or with `stop_after` `commit`, returns an empty result and runs no git command.
- `TestRunLandCheckUnknownRunIsNotFound`.
- `TestRunLandCheckDoesNotWaitForTheRun`: works while a role of another run is busy (it reads the stored record, like `run.render`).

`internal/tui`:
- `TestCardShowsLandWarningWithBlockers`: card pane of an awaiting-approval run whose check returns blockers shows the warning above the approve line, naming the files.
- `TestCardLandWarningTruncatesLongLists`: three names then `+N more`.
- `TestCardWithoutBlockersLooksAsBefore`: the existing approval-card goldens do not change.
- `TestCardLandWarningOutlastsTheLandNoteAt80x24`: when lines drop, the note goes first.
- `TestCardChecksLandingWhenThePaneOpensAndOnEachRefresh`: the fake `Live` logs one `LandCheck` per open and per refresh notice for that run, not per redraw.
- `TestCardShowsNothingWhenTheCheckErrors` or the not-read line, per LM-Q3.
- Goldens `pane-approval-card-landwarn-*` (written first with `-update`, reviewed by eye).

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
Tests first. Do not touch: the landing itself (`land`, `mergeBaseIn`: it must still pause on a blocked fast-forward), the approve key and its human-check rule, `ork approve` output, or any file under `.slicer/`.

1. Preflight: LM-Q1 to LM-Q3 answered in MANIFEST-E.md, or the recommended answers accepted by the owner.
2. `internal/engine/landcheck.go`. `type LandCheck struct { Base string; Blockers []string; Error string }` (JSON `base`, `blockers`, `error`, all omitempty). `CheckLanding` reads, in this order, with `git -C`: `symbolic-ref --short HEAD` in the main checkout (the base; an error or the slice branch is a `LM-Q2` case); `merge-base BASE HEAD` in the worktree; `diff --name-only -z MERGE_BASE` and `ls-files --others --exclude-standard -z` in the worktree; `status --porcelain=v1 -z --untracked-files=all` in the main checkout. Blockers are the paths in both sets (exact match, sorted, de-duplicated). A rename entry in `status` counts both names. Every command is a read through the same runner `gitRead` uses (`internal/engine/round.go:85-89`) with its 30-second timeout. A directory-versus-file clash is not detected; say so in a comment and in the docs.
3. Daemon: `run.landcheck` params `{run}`, result `LandCheck`. It opens the record like `runRender`, returns an empty result unless the state is `awaiting-approval` and `stop_after` is `land` or absent, finds the registered project, and calls `engine.CheckLanding`. It does not take the run lock, so it works while other runs are busy (LM-Q1 recommended answer: a separate read, not part of the snapshot).
4. TUI: ask the daemon through `Live.LandCheck` when the pane of an awaiting-approval run opens and when a change notice refreshes that run, in a command, never in `Update`; keep the last result on the pane state and clear it when the pane closes or the run leaves the state. A failed call shows nothing and does not block any key (LM-Q3). The line, *proposed* wording: `Landing will stop: main has uncommitted changes to A, B, C (+2 more). Commit, stash or remove them first.` Priority: below `cardLandNote` in the drop order, so the note drops first.
5. Docs, *proposed*: `docs/dashboard.md` Approval card (the line, when it shows, that it is a warning and `a` still works, that renames and directory clashes are not seen), `docs/design.md` land step 2 (the pre-check) and the method table, `docs/guide.md` section 10.
6. Goldens: write the new ones with `go test ./internal/tui -update`; every existing approval-card golden must stay byte-identical.
7. CHANGELOG entry last, under `## Unreleased`: `Landing check (*proposed*): ...`. Add it as the final edit so a parallel slice's entry does not conflict.

UI slice: UI pass (r14).

sections.heading: Check
sections.body:
- `go test -race -count=1 ./...`; `go vet ./...`; `gofmt -l .`; `slicer check`; `adj lint`.
- `go test -race -count=1 ./internal/engine ./internal/daemon ./internal/tui`.
- `git diff --stat -- testdata/golden` shows only the two new `landwarn` files.
- [HUMAN CHECK] At 100x30 and 80x24 in a live terminal: start a small slice, dirty a file it changes in the main checkout while it awaits approval, open the pane and read the warning; clean the file and see it go away on the next refresh; leave a `.slicer/` file modified and see no warning.
- [HUMAN CHECK] [AFTER LAND] The next real landing with an unrelated dirty `.slicer/` file shows no warning and lands.
